_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro: You are Player {player_id} in Tic Tac Toe.
player_prompt.goal: Your goal is to win three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) on the board.
player_prompt.instruction: On your turn, you should select the square number (0-8) you want to put your mark in next.
player_prompt.example: For example, '[4]' places your mark in the center cell of the board.
player_prompt.symbol_info: As Player {player_id}, you will be '{symbol}', while your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} is not a valid cell. Must be between 0 and 8.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} placed their symbol ({symbol}) in cell {cell}.
